technical.summary: Strong trend structure and volume spike support bullish momentum, but overbought oscillators and price below intermediate moving averages create pullback risk; moderate swing entry with elevated caution.

fundamental.summary: ROK shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 57 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 1 purchase, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (360.96), flat yield curve signaling recession risk, and earnings event in 57 days create a highly unfavourable environment for ROK despite falling USD providing modest tailwind.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend, 15x volume spike, and three white soldiers pattern combined with extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) create technical momentum setup near support at 195.07.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators, price below both 50-day moving averages, negative CMF/AO, unfavorable macro (VIX crisis, flat yield curve), zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 57 days create a high-probability pullback trap despite technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows ADX strength and 15x volume spike at support, but overbought oscillators and price below 50-day MAs signal pullback risk. Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian opportunity, but macro environment (VIX crisis, flat yield curve) and zero fundamental support make risk/reward unfavorable.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 57 days combined with VIX crisis and recession-signaling yield curve create high probability of sharp reversal despite technical strength; overbought conditions likely to trigger mean reversion before earnings.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents bullish on pattern/volume, but fundamental, risk, and debate agents strongly bearish on macro/earnings/sentiment confluence
decision.portfolio_note: Already 47 positions in Industrials sector (13.5% of portfolio); adding ROK increases concentration risk in unfavorable macro environment without offsetting fundamental conviction.
